data.change_summary: Added a `legacy_pre_stage_state_json` helper in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` so schema v2/v3 migration tests build real pre-stage animal payloads and strip schema-6-only fields before migration. I also aligned the save-load reserve assertions with the current stage-cohort model by checking `AnimalState::total_reserve_g()` and the `animal.total_reserve_g` invariant. The weekly trim/export regression already used `animal.adult.count` and `animal.juvenile.count`, so it required validation rather than another code change.
outstanding_risks: I did not rerun the full `tank_core` test suite; validation covered `save_load` and the targeted 500-hour trim/export regression.

steps.description: Inspected the trim/export regression and confirmed it already uses the stage-cohort animal API in the current branch.
Added a reusable legacy pre-stage save fixture helper and rewired the schema v2/v3 migration tests to use flat-animal payloads without schema-6-only fields.
Updated save-load reserve expectations to use `AnimalState::total_reserve_g()` and the current `animal.total_reserve_g` invariant name.
Ran the save-load regression suite and the targeted 500-hour trim-and-remove regression.
